<div class="sphinxpress-doc">
<section id="wiki-profiles">
<h1>Wiki Profiles</h1>
<p>WikiMason supports three peer wiki profiles. The profile determines how pages
are stored on disk, how metadata is formatted, and how links are rendered.</p>
<table class="docutils align-default">
<thead>
<tr class="row-odd"><th class="head"><p>Profile</p></th>
<th class="head"><p>Metadata</p></th>
<th class="head"><p>Body format</p></th>
<th class="head"><p>Page layout</p></th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">markdown</span></code></p></td>
<td><p>YAML frontmatter</p></td>
<td><p>Standard Markdown</p></td>
<td><p>Nested directories</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-odd"><td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">obsidian</span></code></p></td>
<td><p>YAML frontmatter</p></td>
<td><p>Standard Markdown</p></td>
<td><p>Nested directories</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">logseq</span></code></p></td>
<td><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">property::</span></code> lines</p></td>
<td><p>Outliner blocks</p></td>
<td><p>Flat <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pages/</span></code> directory</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>All profiles share the same logical page model, command vocabulary, and source
tracking. Switching profiles changes the on-disk layout without changing the
logical content.</p>
<section id="selecting-a-profile">
<h2>Selecting a profile</h2>
<section id="initialise-a-new-vault-with-a-specific-profile">
<h3>Initialise a new vault with a specific profile</h3>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>wikimason<span class="w"> </span>init<span class="w"> </span>markdown<span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>PATH<span class="o">]</span>
wikimason<span class="w"> </span>init<span class="w"> </span>obsidian<span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>PATH<span class="o">]</span>
wikimason<span class="w"> </span>init<span class="w"> </span>logseq<span class="w"> </span><span class="o">[</span>PATH<span class="o">]</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="check-the-active-profile">
<h3>Check the active profile</h3>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>wikimason<span class="w"> </span>config<span class="w"> </span>show<span class="w"> </span>--format<span class="w"> </span>json
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="profile-configuration">
<h2>Profile configuration</h2>
<p>Profiles can be overridden in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">wikimason.toml</span></code>:</p>
<div class="highlight-toml notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="k">[wiki]</span>
<span class="n">profile</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;logseq&quot;</span>

<span class="k">[profile.logseq]</span>
<span class="n">flat_pages</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span>
<span class="n">property_style</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;logseq&quot;</span>
<span class="n">outliner_prefix</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;- &quot;</span>
<span class="n">pages_dir</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;pages&quot;</span>

<span class="k">[profile.obsidian]</span>
<span class="n">hub_filename</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;_index.md&quot;</span>
<span class="n">exclude</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">&quot;.obsidian/workspace.json&quot;</span><span class="p">]</span>

<span class="k">[profile.markdown]</span>
<span class="n">hub_filename</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;index.md&quot;</span>
<span class="n">pages_dir</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Wiki&quot;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
